trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops automatically once the other 54 are earned — treat it as the finish line, not a separate task. The real gatekeeper is A Long Road, so plan your whole run around the 100% checklist in the roadmap.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story mission, unmissable. Play through the opening: it introduces Jason and Lucia and ends with your first free taste of Leonida.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. Before the chapter ends, meditate on Lucia's balcony at Jason's house — it may count toward Positive Mental Attitude and may not come back (see the missable warning on trophy 28).

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Keep a manual save at the start of each mission — there is no mission replay, so a clean chapter run depends on your saves.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. Warning: the Race Against Yago sequence in this chapter is time-sensitive — keep a recent save before it starts, per outputlag.
trophies.warning: Race Against Yago is time-sensitive in Chapter 3 — keep a recent save before it.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. By now the map is fully open; use the quiet stretches between missions to clear side content.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission. Gold trophy, story only — no extra requirements beyond reaching the end.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Finish the mission Breakfast Run. Story mission, unmissable on a full playthrough.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Finish the mission The Cartel Heist. Story mission, unmissable on a full playthrough.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Finish the mission Child's Play. Story mission, unmissable on a full playthrough.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Finish the mission Headliners. Story mission, unmissable on a full playthrough.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Finish the mission VCIA Takedown. Story mission, unmissable on a full playthrough.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Finish the mission Operation Savage Glory. Story mission, unmissable on a full playthrough.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the game: 100% completion. The in-game tracker counts 35 tasks — story, stranger strands, activities, collectibles and exploration. Work through the A Long Road checklist in the roadmap; PowerPyx estimates it is roughly 60% of the true platinum effort.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Stunts stack up naturally while driving, but 250 is a grind. Chain jumps, near-misses and air time; a fast car on a long straight (Ocean Drive) is the easiest farm.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, bowling, arcade, shooting range, drone races, street races, meditation, hunting and more. The in-game Activities tab ticks each one off as you try it.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold medals in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Learn each weapon's recoil pattern first; the pistol and SMG courses are the most forgiving, so clear those early for confidence.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations. A clean line through the gates beats raw speed — learn each course's gate order before pushing.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races across street, off-road and water events. Variety counts, not repeats — rotate event types instead of replaying your favourite.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Match his catch, then out-fish him — better bait and a calm spot help more than fast reeling.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish any arcade game once. Pick the shortest cabinet and play it through — no score target, just completion.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's final mission. Finish Andy's whole strand; side strands unlock as the story progresses, so check back between chapters.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's final mission. Finish Kenton's whole strand; side strands unlock as the story progresses.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's final mission. Finish Billy's whole strand; side strands unlock as the story progresses.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Strangers appear as '?' on the map — clear each strand to the end, not just the first meeting.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's final mission. Finish Randy's whole strand; side strands unlock as the story progresses.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's final mission. Finish Tyrone's whole strand; side strands unlock as the story progresses.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. The spots are scenic viewpoints; the in-game map marks them once found. Do the Chapter 1 balcony spot early (see the missable warning).
trophies.missable: Lucia's Chapter 1 balcony meditation at Jason's house may count toward the 18 and may disappear after Chapter 1. This is UNCONFIRMED: meditate there before finishing Chapter 1 to be safe.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Track it in the wilds of Mount Kalaga — bring a scoped rifle, move slowly, and watch the wind.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards hide in shops, houses and landmarks; the in-game collection screen shows which set each card belongs to, so you can target the gaps.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK photo app at 100 locations. Snap the marked vista at each spot; fast-travel between regions to cut the travel grind.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Combat, driving and exploration challenges stack up over a normal playthrough — check the Challenges tab for the nearest unfinished ones.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Reach a 4-star wanted level with your partner, then lose the cops together. Break line of sight, swap cars, and lay low until the stars clear.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Plan the route first and keep the getaway car close — one failed escape resets the chain.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Drive everything you see; each new model ticks the counter. Traffic variety and vehicle meets are the fastest way to fill the gaps.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Group enemies first, then trigger Focus in a tight space where they can't scatter.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA: steal a plane and take off without clearance. Expect a wanted level the moment you roll.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Rhino tanks — steal one or survive one. The military base is the reliable spawn; go in fast and get out faster.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go at night, silence the cameras, and don't trip the alarm — stealth gear helps.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Vaults are the big scores — bring your partner, a fast car, and a route out before you go in.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Block it, crack it, and vanish before backup arrives.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. The map fills in as you travel; mop up the last few remote areas with a helicopter sweep.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs — one per gang. Scout first; gangs defend their turf hard.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Find the beachfront bar at sunset and order one.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Pick a showroom, pick a fast car, and go through the glass.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play bowling at the Kolt & Associates alley. Finish a full game — no score target.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership moment with mass appeal. Build your partnership up through shared activities and the moment triggers on its own.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make choices — the counter tracks 500 choices across the game. Keep playing and deciding; it fills up over a full playthrough.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Succeed on a second try. Fail something, then nail it on the retry — it pops naturally if you don't reload a save after every mistake.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness something strange. Leonida hides odd encounters — explore the weird corners of the map, especially at night.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by — a melee attack from a moving vehicle. Slow the car, line it up, swing.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of marked bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from heists — launder steadily rather than in one rush.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Weapons, clothes, cars and properties all count — it adds up over a full playthrough.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties. Save up — garages also store your vehicle collection, so they pay for themselves.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Photograph and register 10 different rides.

notes: Guides are written in our own words. Official names, descriptions and grades: Exophase. Methods and missable flags: cryptogames.gg, keengamer.com, outputlag.com, PowerPyx/GTABase.
